claims.statement: Versioned conformance target, principles, testable criteria, complete-process scope, accessibility-supported use, and criterion-level applicability. Cross-platform evidence composition, profile semantics, exceptions, and operational controls are Xonovex synthesis.
Programmatic role, state, property, and accessibility-tree semantics. Platform-specific implementation remains with the owning platform skill.

notes.title: Refresh Workflow
notes.text:
1. Re-check the current WCAG Recommendation, errata, conformance requirements, and supported-technique guidance.
2. Re-run exact-revision, known-pass, known-fail, unsupported-content, stale-evidence, exception, and outage assessment cases.
3. Keep accessibility assurance separate from certification and legal-compliance claims and update **Last reviewed**.
